faqs.q: Sec. 6-166. - Changing, altering, or modifying a common consumption area or entertainment district.
faqs.a:
(a)
Common consumption area.
After the issuance of a common consumption area license, a licensee shall make no
               physical change, alteration, or modification to the common consumption area which
               alters the boundaries or the usage of the common consumption area from the plans and
               specifications submitted at the time of the original license application without first
               filing a new application and paying a new license fee pursuant to
section 6-163
. Changes, alterations, and modifications must receive approval of the authority after
               a public hearing held pursuant to
section 6-164
.
(b)
Entertainment district.
The boundaries of an entertainment district may not be expanded, enlarged, reduced,
               or modified without approval from city council through a resolution.
(
Ord. No. 4804
, § 1, 6-6-2022)
